title: Conduit University Ambassador Program
paragraphs: The Conduit University Ambassador Program connects ambitious students with cutting-edge research in human-computer interaction and neurotechnology. As a campus ambassador, you'll help bring paid research opportunities to your university community while gaining experience on the forefront of AI/BCI research.

Campus ambassadors play a crucial role in expanding the scope and quality of our research. Your main priority will be recruiting participants for paid studies, and you'll provide feedback based on those sessions that directly shapes our product development. You'll be paid a contingency fee of $20 per referral.

Ideal candidates are entrepreneurial, passionate about technology, and well-connected within their campus community. You'll receive training, support, and compensation for your efforts in building the Conduit presence at your school.
closing: Join us in bringing cutting-edge research opportunities to your campus community.
